                    log("final seg " .. n .. "/" .. totalSegs .. ": '" .. text .. "'")
                    onSegmentText(text, effectiveLang)
                end, langArgs)
                wTask:start()
            end
        end, { "-y", "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", concatFile, "-c", "copy", segWav })
        concatTask:start()
